title: Monedas Ocaso
description: This mod adds three coins to the game. A golden coin, a silver coin and a bronze coin. These coins cannot be crafted and no mob drops them.
body:
# Monedas Ocaso
This mod adds three coins to the game. These coins cannot be crafted and no mob drops them.

## How to get them?
They can be obtained from creative mode in the tools section or with the commands:

**/give @a monedas_ocaso:moneda_oro**

**/give @a monedas_ocaso:moneda_plata**

**/give  @a monedas_ocaso:moneda_bronce**
